quest.title: Vigilance at Sea
quest.description: During Lantern Rite, Huixing, the navigator of the Crux fleet seems to be preparing for a unique training test...

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Looking great, no? All of the decorations were handpicked by the Captain. She wanted her brothers and sisters on duty to feel like they were at home for the festival!

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Not only that, before the Lantern Rite, the Captain gave each of us a bonus and organized several big feasts.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: The food for every feast is ordered from reputable restaurants, such as the Wanmin Restaurant, which we always frequent, and Xinyue Kiosk and Liuli Pavilion.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Everyone ate and drank their fill!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants to check those out, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, a bonus and a feast? That's great! Paimon had no idea that Beidou also had such an eye for detail!

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Actually, the Captain has always been meticulously keeping the fleet's affairs in order.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Not only do we crew members get paid very well, but during past Lantern Rites, she's also prepared gifts for our families!

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Before, the Captain got some business information from the Tianquan on how to improve management strategy for the Crux.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: The revenue of the fleet has soared, so the Captain has also increased our pay. In this way, the crew will be in tip-top shape for any challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: When the new recruits hear about how well the Crux fleet treats its crew, they'll be extra motivated.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? During Lantern Rite, shouldn't everyone be on vacation? You guys seem to be... working overtime.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: It's not like that, don't worry!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The Captain has done all the research in advance. Some of the crew were given early leave, while the others were given days off later on.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Thus, everyone gets time off, and there will always be someone to man the Alcor!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: I was among the group that got earlier vacation time, and I came back to my post completely refreshed! I'm currently getting ready for my training examination: "Vigilance at Sea."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Vigilant... what now?

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Yup! You guessed it!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: During the past two years, the volume of seaborne trade in Liyue Harbor has been soaring, and many people have joined up as sailors.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Taking to the high seas is a matter of patience, bravery, and perception. These are highly demanded qualities. Sailors have to be well-trained in order to navigate safely.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: In addition to obtaining the four major qualifications and the five minor qualifications, which total nine navigation-related qualifications stipulated by the Ministry of Civil Affairs, two years of maritime training and apprenticeship are also required.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nine qualifications and two more years of training!? Holy mackerel!!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's so demanding!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: It's no big deal. After all, it's far better to undergo rigorous training in preparation for work than to go out to sea and encountering an unpleasant surprise, unprepared.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs organizes most of the training courses. Anyone with a passable knowledge of sailing could coast by them. These subjects aren't too difficult.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Of course, some ships will also have to traverse dangerous waters, which will hopefully give them some experience.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Given the experience of the Crux fleet in dealing with rough sea situations, we and the Ministry of Civil Affairs have organized an intensive navigation training program.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Sailors who pass the training will get a "Deep Sea Navigation Qualification" certificate on completion, as well as some rewards prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Considering I have the best knowledge of the surrounding waters, the Captain has tasked me with planning this training examination...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Wait a minute. Speaking of sailing, you two are pretty good with that Waverider, no? Do you guys want to give it a try?

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: If you don't mind, I would also like you guys to give me some feedback about this test, positive or negative. That way, I will be able to improve it in a timely manner!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon wants to see how much skill the crew needs to navigate the high seas...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there's a bonus reward, too. It's a win-win for us!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Such vigor! Then I'll mark you guys down for the "Vigilance at Sea" examination. Please do your best!

choices.text: Let's experience what it's like to be a sailor!
Is it to do with the new recruits?

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you! Paimon also wishes you well!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, how do you know us? Are you...

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I'm Huixing, the navigator of the Crux fleet. I'm also responsible for fleet-related events for this Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I heard about your stories from Captain Beidou. You guys are also brave heroes, how admirable!

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: If you have any questions about the Alcor, I will do my best to give you a detailed, thorough answer!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How nice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We definitely want to know more about the Alcor, and if we're curious about anything, we'll definitely ask you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In fact, this time, the Alcor has a lot of seaborne goods and decorations, and it's as bustling as in the city!

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: #Long time no see, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you, Huixing! Paimon also wishes you well!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've seen that the Alcor has a lot of seaborne goods and decorations, and it's as bustling as in the city!
